children: Franco-Nevada reported Q3 revenue of $549.3M, up 13% from Q3 2025, while GEOs sold fell 6% to 130,435. The company said it is tracking toward the mid-range of annual guidance.
Material Details
Detail
AI Analyst View
Q3 revenue $549.3M, up 13% year over year
Revenue growth reflects stronger commodity prices and increased PGM and energy contributions; GEOs sold declined 6%.
GEOs sold fell 6% to 130,435
Lower gold-stream and iron-ore contributions offset higher energy contributions, tempering the revenue increase.
Annual GEO guidance narrowed toward midpoint
Management said strong energy prices lifted diversified revenue, while lower production at two assets reduced year-to-date precious-metal GEOs.
Quarterly dividend declared at US$0.44 per share
The dividend is payable December 17, 2026, to holders of record December 3; no prior-period comparison was provided.
Cobre Panamá stream deliveries began in Q3
Expected deliveries are approximately 23,100 gold ounces and 265,000 silver ounces, subject to copper concentrate sales.
$10.3M partial impairment reversal for Cobre Panamá
The reversal reflects expected stream ounces following government authorization; further reversals remain under assessment.
Context by AI Analyst

This is a quarterly update for an established royalty and streaming company, with revenue growth alongside lower GEO sales and asset-specific production constraints. Further upside would depend on sustained commodity prices, delivery performance, and progress toward a Cobre Panamá agreement or potential restart.
